lines.zh: 铁靴碾过碎石，一步一顿
lines.en: Steel boots grind the gravel, one heavy step at a time.
My plate clatters as I push steadily on.
Slow is fine; heavy plate fears nothing.
With the yellow banner ahead, I tramp through the dust.

lines.zh: 每一步都震得地面发抖
lines.en: Every step makes the ground shudder.
I keep my pace short and my patience long.
Shield raised, I close in slowly.
No warhorse today; the armor still marches.
My cape sweeps the grass as I advance.
Not fast, but I do not fall back.
Plate rings against plate like a marching drum.
I trace the wall for one more patrol.
I lean on my polearm and keep watch.
Visor down, only my breathing shows.
The longer I stand, the heavier the plate.
I wait for a horn, not for wind.

lines.zh: 骑士的耐心比特盾还厚
lines.en: A knight's patience is thicker than his shield.
My fingers tap inside the gauntlet.
The sun bakes the iron; I do not move.
I shift the hammer from left hand to right.
A yellow strip sways at my shoulder.

lines.zh: 没人来换岗，我就一直站
lines.en: No relief comes, so here I stand.
I count the distant caws of crows.
Breathing inside this helm sounds muffled.
I look up and size up your weapon.

lines.zh: 你站在射程里，说明来意
lines.en: You stand within reach; state your business.
My gaze stops at your hands.
Not so close; the iron will bruise you.

lines.zh: 我认得那身装备，是杂牌
lines.en: I know that kit; it is a patchwork.
You lowered your shield an inch.
Behind the visor I measure the distance.

lines.zh: 黄方骑士不躲人的目光
lines.en: A yellow knight does not dodge a stare.

lines.zh: 你这样看我，是想试试吗
lines.en: Staring like that, do you want to try?
I turn my thickest plate toward you.
Your steps waver; mine do not.

lines.zh: 我缓慢点头，算打过招呼
lines.en: I give a slow nod, which counts as greeting.
The plate dents, and so do I.
That one landed squarely.
I grunt and hold my ground.
Iron saved the bone, but not all of it.
You opened a seam.
It hurts, but I can still lift the hammer.

lines.zh: 甲里全是我喘气的声音
lines.en: My breathing fills the helm.
I sway, then steady.
This wound needs the armorer, not a healer.
Heavy plate still feels pain.
That stew smells good enough to loosen plate.
Set the supplies down and I may not chase.

lines.zh: 我咽了口口水，面甲一响
lines.en: I swallow, and the visor clicks.
Even an iron stomach craves something hot.

lines.zh: 若你给面包，我记你一分情
lines.en: Give me bread and I will owe you a favor.
The smell gets through the seams; unfair.
I take half a step. Only half.
This is not surrender; this is dinner.

lines.zh: 我的肚子在甲里叫了一声
lines.en: My stomach rumbles inside the armor.
Put the food down and back away three steps.
Plate meets plate with a bright crack.
Stand firm, or my weight takes you down.

lines.zh: 我被撞退半步，随即归位
lines.en: Knocked back half a step, I settle back.
You just hit thirty pounds of iron.
Make way; my turns are slow.
My pauldron gives you a nudge.
A shove only settles me firmer.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，像两扇门
lines.en: We clang together like two gates.
I raise a hand so you miss the hammer.
Iron flakes fall; do not breathe in.
My oath outranks any wedding.
If you wear yellow too, we stand together.
In armor I speak of no private matters.
We touch shields; that seals an alliance.
I tear my yellow strip and hand you half.
This understanding holds firmer than vows.
Fight beside me; ask no more.

lines.zh: 我的盔缨与你的系在一起
lines.en: My crest is tied to yours.

lines.zh: 名字不必交换，旗色够了
lines.en: No names needed; colors suffice.
We guard the same stretch of wall.

lines.zh: 我用护手夹起那枚钉子
lines.en: I pinch the nail up with a gauntlet.
Loose iron on the ground is mine.
Bending is hard work, but I pick it up.
This can patch armor; I keep it.
I lift it and weigh it in my palm.
Who dropped this? I hold it for now.
In this plate, picking things up looks like bowing.
I stuff the trophy into my belt pouch.
I know this badge; I keep it.
Whatever lies on the ground counts as supply.
Found you. You.
I raise my hand: the fight begins.
Target sighted; the plate tightens by habit.
You are inside hammer range.
Do not run; it will not help.
The banner dips, and I advance.
The yellow ledger is settled now.
I turn slowly and square up to you.
Range is good; I take the first step.
I will not ask your name.
The haft turns half a circle in my grip.
One plate clicks; that is the signal.
I cut off your way back.
Still following. Do not look back.
You circle; I walk straight.
Each step shortens the gap.
I watch your feet, not your face.
You breathe faster than I do.
A slow chase is still a chase.
I step in the prints you left.
Circling is useless; I hold the center.
My hammer keeps pointing at you.

lines.zh: 你数我的步，我数你的汗
lines.en: You count my steps; I count your sweat.
I go around the tree and continue.
Do not count on losing me.
The clatter is my footstep.
The more you hurry, the slower I go.

lines.zh: 我停在射程边缘等你犯错
lines.en: I wait at the edge of reach for your mistake.
Nightfall does not hinder me.
I know this path; you do not.
The hammer falls and dents the ground.
Take a wide swing.
I aim for your shield.
There is force behind this plate.
This one lands half a beat late.
I wind up fully before the blow.
You retreat; the hammer follows.
Iron on iron numbs the hands.
I push you toward the wall.
The hammerhead grazes your shoulder.
Do not block it; blocking hurts more.
Blow by blow, I am in no hurry.
That one came from the hips.
Did you hear the wind of it?
I recover the hammer and lift again.
This plate allows only straight blows.
Stand still so I strike true.
For the last one I drop my weight low.
The plates settle; I wake.
The yellow banner rises; I stand beneath it.
Who called me out of the wall?
Helm sealed; my view narrows.
I walk out of the fog.
The weight of iron comforts me.
I am not warmed up yet; wait.
Which stretch of the line is this?
I snap a dry branch underfoot.
Where the order is, I go.

lines.zh: 新来的都得先看我一眼
lines.en: Newcomers always look at me first.
I stand still; only then does the dust settle.
Fire heats the iron, and the iron burns me.
My knee guard hits first on landing.
Water pours in through the seams.
The blast lifts me off my feet.
An arrow wedges in a seam.
Spellforce passes the plate and finds bone.
Thick plate, empty stomach.
Lightning runs down the iron through me.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地面给我的靴
lines.en: The void gives my boots no ground.
